sources.title: romara-labs/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-ONNX · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-ONNX is the optimization of the Qwen3-TTS framework. This model implements a discrete multi-codec Language Model (LM) architecture capable of 3-second rapid voice cloning with enhanced prosody and vocal fidelity. The ONNX conversion enables low-latency, cross-platform deployment on both high-end CPUs and NVIDIA GPUs.

sources.title: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign · Models
sources.snippet: We release Qwen3-TTS, a series of powerful speech generation models developed by Qwen, offering comprehensive support for voice cloning, voice design, ultra-high-quality human-like speech generation, and natural language-based voice control.
